item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the 2% skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: I recommend Brrr add a publication phase after implementation, but require explicit authorization before it commits, pushes, opens or merges a pull request, creates a release, or mutates any shared or production system. Should publication remain approval-gated, with the user choosing the authorized actions for each run?
